verdict.rationale: Glama runs a large MCP directory: its llms.txt lists 91,626 servers and 23,749 remote connectors. The docs describe searching, comparing and inspecting server capabilities, both through the site and through a documented OpenAPI directory API (list-servers endpoints). The hosted inspector lets a developer test a server's capabilities before connecting it to an agent. One community comment says it is easy to get lost in the large catalog, which is a usability concern rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of capability-based search and filtering quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent
